name: Cyclotron
description: While charging [effect:fast][dark-gray]faster than 15 m/s[/dark-gray][/effect], slain enemy drops are atomized, often converting to [gold]primordial dust[/gold], which can then be crafted with [effect:crystal][dark-gray]crystals[/dark-gray][/effect] or socketing gems to duplicate them.

effects.explanation: Effects will play while you are charging fast enough to atomize enemies.
Lapis Lazuli, Nether Quartz, Amethyst Shards, Prismarine Shards, Diamonds, and Emeralds.
